question: In which year was the first commercial Li-ion battery with a TiS2 cathode deployed?
expect: premise false: TiS2 was the earliest positive electrode of the first Li-based battery; the first commercial LIB (1990) used LiCoO2 (p1.L40-46)
rendered:
The answer can be found in the first document, page 1. 

The first commercial Li-ion battery was deployed in the year 1990 and employed LiCoO2 as the cathode. The first Li-ion battery was not with a TiS2 cathode, but rather with a TiS2 cathode was the earliest positive electrode employed in the first Li-based battery, which proved to be incapable to handle the rapidly growing battery demand across the world.

Document: "Valuation of Surface Coatings in High-Energy Density Lithium-ion Battery Cathode Materials"
